lesson.text: Quick memory: where do you go when you hear thunder? (Inside a building.) Today: earthquakes, storms, and what to do if you get lost.
Sometimes the ground shakes: an earthquake. Never run outside while it shakes. Drop, cover, hold on.
Drop onto your hands and knees. Cover: crawl under a strong table. Hold on to a table leg until the shaking stops.
When it stops, wait for your grown-up. They take you outside to open ground, away from buildings and trees.
When thunder roars, go indoors. Never shelter under a big tree: lightning can strike tall things.
Lost in the woods? Stay where you are and hug a tree. When you hear your name, shout back: here I am!
Try it in the world: open the practice room and do the drill. Next: floods, heat and more, on the Middle track.

exercises.prompt: You should run outside while the ground is shaking.
exercises.explain: False: drop, cover and hold on until it stops.

exercises.prompt: The earthquake drill: put it in order.

choices: hold on until the shaking stops
exercises.hint: The third word of the drill.
exercises.explain: Hold on to the table leg until the shaking stops.

exercises.prompt: You are lost in the woods. You...
choices: stay put and hug a tree
exercises.hint: Make it easy to find you.
exercises.explain: Stay where you are: hug a tree.

exercises.prompt: If you hear people calling your name, you should hide.
exercises.explain: False: shout back! They are looking for you.

exercises.prompt: Safe in a storm, or not safe?
exercises.explain: Inside a building is safe; under a tree or on the field is not.

exercises.prompt: After the shaking stops, where do you go with your grown-up?
exercises.explain: Open ground, away from buildings, trees and wires.

exercises.prompt: Why never shelter under a big tree in a storm?
exercises.explain: Lightning often strikes tall things like a lone tree.

exercises.prompt: Staying in one place helps people find you when you are lost.
exercises.hint: A moving target is harder to find.
exercises.explain: True: they look where you were. Stay put.
